stage: Brand new under 100 followers across all platforms (10 IG, 2 LI, 1 BS)
summary: Account is brand new with minimal engagement. Instagram bio violates brand rules: targets specific niches (hotels, cafes, gyms, homestays) and region (Himachal), states 'ready in 24 hrs' timeframe, and offers free site check permanently instead of only in website posts. Reels lose 77% viewers in first 3 seconds — hook failing.
guidance:
- Rotate to **top3** or **contrast** hooks (question underperforms per reach)
- First 3 seconds must stop scroll: open with a visible pain point or bold statement, no generic intros
- Show developer at work (code, design tool, terminal) — not stock images — so posts read as real work
- For website posts: include 'pay after approval' and 'DM for a free 3-fix site check' (allowed only here)
- Avoid niche/region language; use 2–3 varied Indian business examples per post
- Do not promise speed, rankings, or revenue

instructions.research: List 5 common website trust gaps for small businesses across India (e.g., no professional URL, broken contact forms, outdated info, no mobile view, missing service details) — keep industry-agnostic.
instructions.analysis: Review the 2 previous website posts (1.38x avg): both used top3/contrast hooks. Note which phrasing got any saves/shares. Avoid repeating '24 hrs' or 'Rs 1499' — not in price_note.
instructions.writer: Write a top3 or contrast hook post about why a professional website builds trust vs. only a social bio. Mention 2–3 varied business types (e.g., coaching centre, salon, D2C brand). End with: 'Pay after you approve. DM me — I’ll spot 3 things to fix on your current site.' No price, no timeline.
instructions.image: Capture a real screenshot of your code editor or design file (blurred client data) with a caption like 'Building a clean service page for a coaching centre in Jaipur — mobile-first.' Shows actual work, not a mockup.
instructions.video: If making a reel: first 3 seconds show you typing a component or fixing a layout bug. Overlay text: '3 reasons a bio link isn’t enough.' No talking head. Keep under 30s.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to: 'Websites for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for a free 3-fix site check (website posts only).' Remove niches, region, price, and 24-hr claim.
Comment thoughtfully on 5–10 posts from Indian small business owners (any industry) — ask about their online presence, don’t pitch.
Publish today’s website post with the strongest top3/contrast hook and the real-work image/video.
